title: Zesty Crispy Chinese Smoked Mackerel Noodles
description: A peppery and crispy Chinese dish featuring smoked mackerel, perfect for a weeknight dinner, this recipe is gluten-free friendly and serves 4 people.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, ginger, and garlic.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
Add the smoked mackerel to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crispy.
In a small saucepan, steam the scallions using the mushimono method for 2-3 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked noodles, smoked mackerel, and steamed scallions.
Drizzle the soy sauce mixture and sesame oil over the top of the noodles and toss to combine.
Serve the noodles in a bamboo tray and garnish with additional scallions if desired.
